headline: Your deal here · austin.chat advertising
detail: Pinned/curated entries live in staging/feed_overrides.json. Replace this with real offers, Special Reports, Gossip blurbs, etc. Set an 'expires' (ISO 8601 UTC) so stale ones drop off automatically.

headline: Local business ad · shown only in this neighborhood
detail: Add "neighborhoods": ["nbhd-bouldin-creek"] to target a card to one or more neighborhoods. It appears in the feed only when the visitor is standing in a matching neighborhood; leave it off for a citywide card.
